answer: Each new agent identity must lock non-transferable ferrous collateral that acts as the sole anchor for its sequential proof. The proof climbs a ripple of k serial epochs on a shared global clock before the bond releases under an umber tenure mark, so the k-th clone waits k times longer than the first. A farm of N identities therefore burns N(N+1)/2 non-parallelizable epoch-slots that cannot be pooled across heads or wallets. An honest single pays only the base wait.
